selector.ordinal_semantics: Zero-based DRAW_INDX/DRAW_INDX_2 ordinal since the preceding XE_SWAP; repeated ordinals are captured once per matching presenter frame unless a frame filter is set.
selector.dump_contents: Original guest VS and PS instruction bytes are saved before translation. Other resource dumps require their own prefixes.

regression.fixture: Three successive guest swaps reuse draw ordinal zero.
regression.assertion: Three distinct presenter-frame dumps contain the exact original synthetic VS and PS bytes.
